answer: Give every identity a vault holding a crystal that only grows when distinct peers witness distinct work. Entry is a narrow jetty: a randomly drawn peer seeds the crystal with a live prompt only that newcomer answers, and each later interaction adds a unique facet countersigned by a different peer. Clones start alike, so their crystals stay alike unless the operator does genuinely separate work with separate peers for every clone — at which point the farm is doing the honest work anyway, just multiplied in cost.
